g1.label: 1. Millennials were accused of being too
g1.why: The stereotype was that millennials were too sensitive.

g2.label: 2. Punks used ripped clothes and loud music to
g2.why: Punk style was a way of rejecting mainstream values.

g3.label: 3. Today's subcultures are built around online
g3.why: Modern subcultures form in online communities rather than on the street.

g4.label: 4. Older generations learned patience without
g4.why: They grew up without smartphones, so waiting was normal.

g5.label: 5. Each generation solves problems with the tools
g5.why: Every generation uses whatever tools are available to it.

g6.label: 6. Less screen time means a more ___ life
g6.why: Older relatives assume less screen time equals a more meaningful life.

g7.label: 7. Almost all generations have been
g7.why: The text's point is that each generation gets underestimated in turn.

g8.label: 8. The most useful skill is not to
g8.why: The article argues against judging other generations.

g1.label: 1. Generation Z is ___
g1.why: Long adjectives form the comparative with 'more' before 'than'.

g2.label: 2. Smartphones have made communication ___
g2.why: 'Make' + object + comparative adjective: made communication faster.

g3.label: 3. Punk was one of the ___
g3.why: 'One of the' is followed by a superlative and a plural noun.

g4.label: 4. Online communities are not ___
g4.why: 'Not as … as' compares two things that are not equal.

g5.label: 5. Millennials grew up online, ___
g5.why: 'Whereas' joins two clauses that contrast with each other.

g6.label: 6. ___ (sentence opener)
g6.why: 'Unlike' is a preposition and is followed by a noun, not a clause.

g7.label: 7. This is ___
g7.why: The superlative of 'good' is 'best' and takes 'the'.

g8.label: 8. ___ (sentence opener)
g8.why: 'Both' refers to two groups together and takes a plural verb.

g1.label: 1. people born around the same time
g1.why: A generation is an age group born in the same period.

g2.label: 2. smaller group with its own values
g2.why: A subculture has its own style and values within a wider society.

g3.label: 3. shared by most of society
g3.why: Mainstream describes what the majority accepts as normal.

g4.label: 4. gap between older and younger people
g4.why: The generation gap is the difference in attitudes between age groups.

g5.label: 5. a style that becomes suddenly popular
g5.why: A trend is a style or interest that catches on quickly.

g6.label: 6. judging by beliefs about an age group
g6.why: A stereotype judges an individual by assumptions about their group.

g7.label: 7. customs passed down over years
g7.why: Traditions are customs handed from one generation to the next.

g8.label: 8. sense of who you are
g8.why: Identity is a person's sense of who they are.
